notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's textinput is the host routing needed because its engine-free UI cannot reach the OS clipboard or share an edit law (per-OS chord table, held X11/Wayland pasteboard handle, one EditBoxState law for glue + FrameXML fields). MSUI's text fields are ImGui InputText widgets (chat edit, character-create name, auction search, GM console, creator panels), which natively provide caret movement, selection, Ctrl/Cmd copy-cut-paste against the OS clipboard, and max-length caps - the observable effect Benilla builds by hand.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Two reference niceties are not explicitly reproduced: the character-name box's letters-only filter applied to pasted text, and the 0.5 s caret-blink law (ImGui's own blink differs slightly). Both are cosmetic/input-hygiene level, not gameplay or wire behavior; server-side name validation backstops the filter.
